Subject: Technical deep dive recap  latency/throughput SLOs & deployment topology

Alex  thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our technical deep-dive with Acme:

Summary of pain points and goals
- Current LLM features are inconsistent across regions; peak inference latency spikes to >800ms for 1k tok requests during peak traffic.
- Budget sensitivity: want predictable per-request cost and predictable tail latency for customer-facing chat.
- Need ability to pin model versions and use private VPC deployment for regulated user data.

Agreed SLO targets (we discussed):
- 95th percentile latency target: <= 250ms for 1k-token generation (chat baseline)
- 99th percentile latency: <= 400ms with burst handling
- Throughput: sustained 150 rps for canonical chat route, burst to 500 rps for 30s

Model and deployment requirements
- Primary model: Llama-3-13B (history-aware chat); fallback to quantized 7B variant for cost/burst policy
- KV-cache warmup needs to be preserved across short-lived sessions; prefix caching for common prompts
- Private deployment in AWS us-west-2 with dedicated capacity; encryption with customer KMS

Action items & owners
- Marissa: send SLO table and proposed deployment diagram (attached). DONE
- Michael: follow up with benchmark matrix and recommended instance types + quantization profile. ETA Wed 7/22
- Alex: confirm traffic shape and current peak QPS + retention requirements. ETA Tue 7/21
- Dev: loop in Acme security team for SOC2 evidence request and network diagram. DONE

Attachments: slo-table.csv, redwood-architecture-diagram.png
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-Redwood-ACME-SLOs

Thanks  talk soon,

- Peak shape: we see two daily peaks around 11:30 PST and 15:00 PST. Peak sustained is ~120 rps; we generally see spikes up to 420 rps for ~20-40s when marketing campaigns hit.
- Data retention: chat transcripts retained for 90 days; we need HOOK to purge on-demand for compliance.

Subject: Benchmark plan & instance recommendations for Acme

Alex  following up with the benchmark plan we discussed. Short summary here; full matrix attached (benchmark-matrix.csv):

- Recommended baseline: g5.2xlarge-equivalent GPU instances with FP16 + 4-bit quantization on the 13B model for cost/latency balance.
- For the 95th <=250ms target at 1k tokens: we'll use dedicated capacity with continuous batching tuned to 20ms batching window and prefix caching for common prompts.
- Burst policy: enable GPU pool autoscaling with a warm standby of quantized 7B and fast fallback routing to avoid cold starts.
- KV cache strategy: preserve warmed KV across short sessions by sticky routing within a 60s window.

I'll attach the benchmark CSV and the expected cost run-rate for the configuration. Next steps: if that matches your expectations we'll schedule a 1-hour performance run in your dev account.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
